gbm_population_evidence.quote: Subgroup #2: Histopathologically confirmed recurrent supratentorial WHO grade 3 or 4 malignant glioma (high grade glioma with molecular features of glioblastoma will be eligible under WHO grade 4 malignant glioma)

candidate_evidence.quote: Phase 1 Trial of D2C7-IT in Combination With 2141-V11 for Recurrent Malignant Glioma

[EXPERIMENTAL] D2C7-IT + 2141-V11: Single D2C7-IT intratumoral infusion (4613.2 ng/mL in 36 mL) over 72 hours followed by single 2141-V11 (3.0 mg, RP2D established prior to V5.0) infusion (5 dose levels) over 7 hours.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histopathologically confirmed recurrent supratentorial WHO grade 4 malignant glioma

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Repeated tumor/fluid sampling via the TMD will occur before every perilymphatic injection of 2141-V11, i.e., approximately 2 weeks (+ 1 week) after D2C7-IT, which will be repeated again 2 weeks later and then every 3 weeks for 1 year.
The TMD sampling time can be adjusted from every 3 weeks to every 6 weeks (i.e., every other 2141-V11 infusion) if not enough cellular and genomic material is sampled in the first cohort.

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] D2C7-IT + 2141-V11: Single D2C7-IT intratumoral infusion (4613.2 ng/mL in 36 mL) over 72 hours
D2C7-IT and 2141-V11 will be delivered sequentially directly into the tumor by Convection Enhanced Delivery (CED) using an intracerebral catheter placed within the enhancing portion of the tumor.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational EGFR/EGFRvIII-targeted recombinant immunotoxin (D2C7 antibody fragment fused to Pseudomonas exotoxin), given intratumorally by CED
arms: D2C7-IT + 2141-V11 and Tumor Monorail Device (TMD) Placement

role_evidence.quote: This is a phase 1 study of an anti-CD40 monoclonal antibody (2141-V11) in combination with D2C7-IT for patients with recurrent World Health Organization (WHO) grade III or IV malignant glioma
2141-V11 will be dose escalated during the study to determine the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) when used in combination with D2C7-IT.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational Fc-engineered agonist anti-CD40 monoclonal antibody, intratumoral (CED) and perilymphatic subcutaneous
arms: D2C7-IT + 2141-V11 and Tumor Monorail Device (TMD) Placement

coder_notes: Conditions say only 'Glioma, Malignant'; glioblastoma is named in the inclusion criteria ('high grade glioma with molecular features of glioblastoma will be eligible under WHO grade 4 malignant glioma'), and grade 3 tumours are also eligible -> mixed_glioma_gbm_named. No IDH-wildtype requirement or WHO 2021 citation; 'WHO grade 4 malignant glioma' without IDH -> historical. Both D2C7-IT and 2141-V11 are investigational -> experimental_combination. Both given intratumorally by convection-enhanced delivery via catheter (new_route); device_dependent set false because CED is treated as a route rather than device activation, adjudicator may differ. The Tumor Monorail Device is a device, not an agent. MGMT promoter status appears only in an exclusion criterion about prior chemotherapy (not an entry requirement), so not recorded as a biomarker. EGFR appears only in keywords. Repeated tumour/fluid sampling via the TMD is planned for cellular and genomic material but not explicitly linked to a pharmacodynamic endpoint of the candidates -> target_engagement_planned unclear. Bevacizumab mentioned only as prior/allowed therapy, not a registered intervention; not listed.
